text: My lab (208) investigated heavy versus moderate loading in 20 resistance-trained men who were randomly assigned to one of two groups: a hypertrophy group that performed a bodybuilding-style routine, or a strength group that performed a powerlifting-style routine. The hypertrophy group protocol was a split-body routine in which each muscle was worked once per week with 3 exercises per session, performing 3 sets of 10 repetitions and resting 90 seconds between sets. The strength group protocol was a total-body routine in which each muscle was worked 3 times per week with 1 exercise per session, performing 7 sets of 3 repetitions and resting 3 minutes between sets.
